Functions
diverge_fukui
double* diverge_fukui(
diverge_model_t* 
m,
complex128_t* 
U,
index_t 
nb,
index_t* 
nk
)

Calculate Berry's curvature using the Fukui-Hatsugai method, normed to the Chern number, i.e., the sum of all elements for a certain chern band yields the Chern number of that band, not 2Pi times the Chern number. This function returns an allocated (calloc) array of shape (nk, nb, 3) that contains the Berry curvature along the three crystal axes; not along cartesian axes. The return value can be NULL on errors, and must be freed by users with a call to free or diverge_mem_free.

Parameters
m
diverge_model_t*

model instance. obtain all parameters from there by default. internals must be set (diverge_model_internals_common) in order to have U initialized. if NULL is passed, the function can still operate in case all the other parameters are set accordingly.

U
complex128_t*

orbital to band matrices as (k,b,o) array. Use if != NULL.

nb
index_t

nuber of bands. Use this if > 0.

nk
index_t*

number of k points (3,) array. Use if != NULL.
